# Load Metadata
```{r} 
library(tidyverse) 
MERLIN_QCD <- readRDS("./Project_MERLIN/Analysis/Household_transmission/2025-04-08_final_metadata/results/MERLIN_metadata_041525.RDS")  
sliquefaciens <-  MERLIN_QCD %>% subset(Species =="Serratia liquefaciens") %>% .$Sample %>% sort %>% paste0(.,"_R1.fastq.gz")
writeLines(sliquefaciens,"~/Desktop/gl_nfs/Project_MERLIN/Sequence_data/variant_calling/2025-04-15_SNPKIT/sliquefaciens/sliquefaciens_samples.txt")
```
